name: Jo Bonnier
features: full dark beard, high forehead, calm scholarly face, wire-rimmed glasses off the car, tall lean build
bio: Publishing heir, art collector and the man who gave BRM its first championship victory at Zandvoort in 1959, after nine years of the team failing to win anything. Bearded and donnish in a clean-shaven paddock. Later the driving force behind the Grand Prix Drivers' Association and its safety campaign.
